sq.q: What is disk attachment? Name any two types.
answer: Disk attachment refers to how secondary storage (disks) are connected to the system. Two types:
Host-Attached Storage – connected directly to computer (e.g., SATA)
Network-Attached Storage (NAS) – accessed via a network

lq.q: Explain the structure of a magnetic disk and the various methods of disk attachment in operating systems.
answer: Magnetic disks are the most common secondary storage used in computer systems. Each disk (called a platter ) is coated with magnetic material and data is stored using magnetization.
🔹 Components of Magnetic Disk:
Platters : Circular disks coated with magnetic material.
Platters : Circular disks coated with magnetic material.
Spindle : Holds the platters together and rotates them.
Spindle : Holds the platters together and rotates them.
Read/Write Head : Used to read from or write to the disk.
Read/Write Head : Used to read from or write to the disk.
Arm Assembly : Moves the heads radially.
Arm Assembly : Moves the heads radially.
Track : Circular division on a platter surface.
Track : Circular division on a platter surface.
Sector : Pie-shaped wedge of a track (smallest storage unit).
Sector : Pie-shaped wedge of a track (smallest storage unit).
Cylinder : All tracks aligned vertically on multiple platters.
Cylinder : All tracks aligned vertically on multiple platters.
